title: Courses per department
statementMd:
How many courses does each department offer, and how many credits in total?

Expected columns: `department`, `courses`, `credits`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS courses, SUM(credits) AS credits FROM courses GROUP BY department;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
